posts.title: Justice x GTA VI: They Didn’t Come for the Music. And Yet.
posts.description: Justice’s Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score is due on 11 December 2026 through Because Music, Ed Banger and Rockstar Games. The announced release contains 30 tracks and digital extras, amounting to around three hours. Michael McDonald, Gesaffelstein, Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard appear on the songs presented so far.

posts.title: Friday Column #4: When You Wear a Copy, What Do You Call Your Perfume?
posts.description: Perfumes sold as “inspired by” promise a familiar scent for less money. I understand the appeal. They also make me wonder how much of the original survives in our desire, right down to the name we give when someone asks what we are wearing.

posts.title: Yves Saint Laurent’s Le Smoking Turns 60
posts.description: Only one haute couture client bought the original Le Smoking in 1966. Sixty years later, its anniversary invites a closer look at its younger audience, Helmut Newton’s photograph and the freedom to wear it differently.
